_comment: The `canonical` audit is switched off and the SEO threshold sits at 0.9 for
one reason only: Lighthouse runs against http://localhost:3000 while the
pages correctly declare canonicals on https://www.primebodylab.de, which
Lighthouse reports as 'points to another hreflang location'. It cannot pass
outside production. Canonical and hreflang correctness is asserted exactly,
URL by URL, in e2e/seo.spec.ts — a stronger check than the score.
Every other SEO audit must still pass.
